milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because the crafted bowl ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with 3 oak planks (no bowl), so this rule is not pre-satisfied. The bowl recipe (3 planks in V-shape on a crafting table) produces 4 bowls, but we check for min_count=1 to be robust. inventory_has is the preferred rule type for craft tasks since the crafted item always appears in inventory.
